# Food juice: This is the easiest way to get food juice for the Boy Scout Challenges

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_200_nukaknights-post-futtersaft-royaljelly.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## There are 2 types of feed juice

- **Food juice as food** (consumable and usable for recipes)
Wiki: https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Royal_jelly_(consumable)
- **Feed juice as scrap** (can only be scrapped into glass and antiseptic)
Wiki: https://fallout.fandom.com/wiki/Royal_jelly_(junk)

The "Junk Feed Juice" can be found as loot from Honeybeasts, and you can find one next to a motorcycle on the highway southwest of Grafton Train Station.

What you are looking for is the consumable feed juice. You can use this to cook "**Crispy Honey Blackberries**" (Wiki) for the **Girl Scout Cooking Challenge**. You can find him in the following locations in **Appalachia** and in your **CAMP**. The locations listed have a **spawn rate of 50%** for the food sap. So it's possible that none can be found in one place or another. Then of course changing server helps. 

## This is how you find feed juice in Appalachia

### Middle mountain station

Even before Patch 44 you could find food juice here. However, there is now a fence behind the hut where the basket with the feed juice was. You can now find the food juice under the table that is on the western wall near the flag.

![Futtersaft at the Mittelbergstation](/uploads/nukaknights-futtersaft-royaljelly-locations-royaljelly-detail1.jpg) 

### Bed & Breakfast

Here you will find 3x food juice in different rooms. Once in the kitchen.

![Feed juice in the kitchen at Bed & Breakfast](/uploads/nukaknights-futtersaft-royaljelly-locations-royaljelly-detail2.jpg) 

![Food juice in the closet at Bed & Breakfast on the upper floor](/uploads/nukaknights-futtersaft-royaljelly-locations-royaljelly-detail3.jpg) 

![Feed juice at the Bed & Breakfast on the lower floor on a table near the entrance](/uploads/nukaknights-futtersaft-royaljelly-locations-royaljelly-detail4.jpg) 

### Tanagra Town

The 5th food juice in Appalachia can be found in Tanagra Town. Right at the top, really at the top of half a floor in a bathtub.

![Food juice in Tanagra Town at the top of the bathtub](/uploads/nukaknights-futtersaft-royaljelly-locations-royaljelly-detail5.jpg) 

If you want to farm more than these 5 in the locations shown, you have to empty your loot list and loot 255 items so that these food juices spawn for you again. See also: Respawning items and enemies, how does it work?

## Feed juice from the collector

In order to farm feed juice from the Kollektron you need the **Fastnacht Kollektron**. In addition to collecting sweets such as: Sugar bombs (with RAD, can be used for brain bombs) also food juice with 6.25% chance. Empty your Kollektron container regularly to have more chances of getting food juice.

*Tip: Use any other collector and switch it to “Fasnacht treats” at the terminal. The singing of the Fastnacht Kollektron can be a bit annoying.*

![Food juice from the Kollektron](/uploads/nukaknights-futtersaft-kollektron-3-edit.jpg)
